```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(jsonlite)

base_dir <- "/Users/fuminli/Desktop/CARDIAC-FM/figure_numbers_new/fig3_external_zeroshot"
json_file <- file.path(base_dir, "fig23_numbers_our3_ecgfm1.json")
pval_file <- "/Users/fuminli/Desktop/CARDIAC-FM/figure_numbers_new/pval_vs_riskscore.json"
out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "plot_rs_vs_ai")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x)) y else x
}

fig_json <- fromJSON(json_file, simplifyVector = FALSE)
pval_json <- fromJSON(pval_file, simplifyVector = FALSE)

parse_fig23_json_metrics <- function(fig_json) {
  rows <- list()

  for (key in names(fig_json)) {
    if (startsWith(key, "_")) next

    key_parts <- str_split_fixed(key, "\\|", 2)
    dataset_i <- key_parts[, 1]
    label_i <- key_parts[, 2]
    entry <- fig_json[[key]]
    models_i <- unique(c(
      names(entry$auroc$bars %||% list()),
      names(entry$auprc$bars %||% list())
    ))

    for (model_i in models_i) {
      auroc_i <- entry$auroc$bars[[model_i]]
      auprc_i <- entry$auprc$bars[[model_i]]

      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
        dataset = dataset_i,
        label = label_i,
        model = model_i,
        n = entry$n,
        pos = entry$pos,
        neg = entry$neg,
        auroc = auroc_i$point %||% NA_real_,
        auroc_ci_lo = auroc_i$ci_lo %||% NA_real_,
        auroc_ci_hi = auroc_i$ci_hi %||% NA_real_,
        auprc = auprc_i$point %||% NA_real_,
        auprc_ci_lo = auprc_i$ci_lo %||% NA_real_,
        auprc_ci_hi = auprc_i$ci_hi %||% NA_real_
      )
    }
  }

  bind_rows(rows)
}

rs_models <- c(
  "Risk Score",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG) +RS",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG+MRI) +RS"
)

model_labels <- c(
  "Risk Score" = "Risk Score",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG) +RS" = "CARDIAC-FM (ECG) + Risk Score",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG+MRI) +RS" = "CARDIAC-FM (ECG+MRI) + Risk Score"
)

model_colors <- c(
  "Risk Score" = "#B8A64B",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG) +RS" = "#009E73",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG+MRI) +RS" = "#56B4E9"
)

model_display_colors <- setNames(model_colors[names(model_labels)], model_labels)

parse_pval_vs_riskscore <- function(pval_json) {
  rows <- list()

  for (key in names(pval_json)) {
    key_parts <- str_split_fixed(key, "\\|", 3)
    dataset_i <- key_parts[, 1]
    label_i <- key_parts[, 2]
    entry <- pval_json[[key]]

    for (metric_i in c("auroc", "auprc")) {
      pval_metric <- if (metric_i == "auroc") "roc" else "prc"
      metric_entry <- entry[[pval_metric]]

      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
        dataset = dataset_i,
        label = label_i,
        model = entry$model,
        metric = metric_i,
        delta_vs_risk_score = metric_entry$delta %||% NA_real_,
        p_vs_risk_score = metric_entry$p %||% NA_real_,
        sig_vs_risk_score = isTRUE(metric_entry$sig)
      )
    }
  }

  bind_rows(rows)
}

pval_table <- parse_pval_vs_riskscore(pval_json)

metrics <- parse_fig23_json_metrics(fig_json) %>%
  filter(model %in% rs_models) %>%
  mutate(
    dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c("UKB", "CHS", "MESA")),
    label_display = factor(
      recode(label, af5 = "AF", hf5 = "HF"),
      levels = c("AF", "HF")
    ),
    model = factor(model, levels = rs_models),
    model_display = factor(model_labels[as.character(model)], levels = model_labels[rs_models])
  )

write_csv(metrics, file.path(out_dir, "rs_vs_cardiacfm_plus_rs_metrics.csv"))
write_csv(pval_table, file.path(out_dir, "rs_vs_cardiacfm_plus_rs_pval_vs_riskscore.csv"))

make_metric_df <- function(df, metric_i) {
  df %>%
    transmute(
      dataset,
      label,
      label_display,
      model,
      model_display,
      value = .data[[metric_i]],
      ci_lo = .data[[paste0(metric_i, "_ci_lo")]],
      ci_hi = .data[[paste0(metric_i, "_ci_hi")]]
    )
}

plot_dumbbell <- function(df, metric_i) {
  point_df <- make_metric_df(df, metric_i) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
    left_join(
      pval_table %>% filter(metric == metric_i),
      by = c("dataset", "label", "model")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c("UKB", "CHS", "MESA")),
      model = factor(model, levels = rs_models),
      sig_label = ifelse(coalesce(sig_vs_risk_score, FALSE), "*", "")
    ) %>%
    group_by(dataset, label_display) %>%
    arrange(model, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      model_index = row_number(),
      n_models = n(),
      x_base = as.numeric(label_display),
      x_pos = x_base + (model_index - (n_models + 1) / 2) * 0.22
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  metric_label <- toupper(metric_i)
  y_min <- min(point_df$ci_lo, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(point_df$ci_hi, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_pad <- max(0.025, (y_max - y_min) * 0.18)
  y_lower <- max(0, floor((y_min - y_pad) * 20) / 20)
  y_upper <- min(1, ceiling((y_max + y_pad) * 20) / 20)

  ggplot(point_df, aes(x = x_pos, y = value, color = model_display)) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi),
      width = 0.12,
      linewidth = 0.55,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 3.2) +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = ci_hi + y_pad * 0.18, label = sig_label),
      size = 6.5,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black",
      vjust = 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ dataset, nrow = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = model_display_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(levels(point_df$label_display)),
      labels = levels(point_df$label_display),
      limits = c(0.55, length(levels(point_df$label_display)) + 0.45),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.05),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.05))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_lower, y_upper)) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = metric_label,
      color = NULL,
      caption = "* CARDIAC-FM + Risk Score significantly outperformed Risk Score\n(paired bootstrap p<0.05)."
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "center",
      legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "cm"),
      legend.margin = margin(b = 4),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#E2E6EC", linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 12), face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 24, 24, 46)
    )
}

save_plot <- function(p, name, width = 10.2, height = 5.2) {
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), p, width = width, height = height, device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
}
```

```{r}
all_plots <- list()

for (metric_i in c("auroc", "auprc")) {
  p_abs <- plot_dumbbell(metrics, metric_i)

  all_plots[[paste0(metric_i, "_absolute")]] <- p_abs

  save_plot(p_abs, paste0("rs_vs_cardiacfm_plus_rs_", metric_i, "_dumbbell"))
}

length(all_plots)
```
